The [[Ceremonial Spear (unique)|Ceremonial Spear]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[spear]] traded by [[Adept of Spears]], a [[collector]] in the [[Divine Path]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 14-27 (Requires 9 [[Spear Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Armor penetration]] +20% (Chance: 20%)
:Health +30

*[[Courage of the Forgotten]], [[Deldrimor Impaler]], [[Droknar's Spear]], [[Mallyx's Strife]], and [[Spear of the Kinslayer]] have stats identical to this item.
